hook: Graph diffusion models do memorize, after all

beats.say: A new paper by Adarsh Jamadandi and Nicolas Keriven is titled Your Discrete Graph Diffusion Model is Secretly Memorizing.
These models add noise to nodes and edges. A denoiser trained on a single graph seems to generate novel graphs, and metrics like edge overlap find no sign of memorization.
By analyzing the reverse diffusion trajectories, the authors show for the first time that graph diffusion models do memorize. The work goes to the NeurIPS Bento workshop in Sydney.
